metadata.dataset_name: aabesh — Kolkata Durga Puja Pandal Master Dataset
metadata.generated_for: aabesh Platform — Kolkata Durga Puja Discovery, Rating & Navigation
metadata.notes: This dataset covers major famous pandals, heritage Bonedi Bari pujas, community favourites, and hidden gems across Kolkata. Coordinates have been sourced from Google Maps, Wikipedia, Wikimapia, and pandal directory websites. Themes are year-dependent and intentionally left blank for current year unless confirmed. All data cross-referenced from minimum 2 independent sources where possible.

clusters.name: North Kolkata Heritage Trail
clusters.recommended_order: Sovabazar Rajbari → Bagbazar Sarbojanin → Kumartuli Park → Ahiritola Sarbojanin → Kashi Bose Lane
clusters.notes: Walkable heritage circuit in narrow lanes. Best experienced on foot.

clusters.name: North Kolkata Modern Circuit
clusters.recommended_order: College Square → Hatibagan Sarbojanin → Manicktala Chaltabagan → Tala Prattay
clusters.notes: Mix of modern theme pujas and traditional celebrations

clusters.name: Central Kolkata Grand Circuit
clusters.recommended_order: Mohammad Ali Park → College Square → Santosh Mitra Square
clusters.notes: High-budget grand spectacle pandals. Expect very heavy crowds.

clusters.name: South Kolkata Gariahat-Ballygunge Belt
clusters.recommended_order: Deshapriya Park → Tridhara Sammilani → Samaj Sebi Sangha → Ballygunge Cultural → Singhi Park → Ekdalia Evergreen
clusters.notes: Dense cluster of award-winning theme pujas. Walking tour recommended.

clusters.name: Chetla–New Alipore Creative Hub
clusters.nearby_metro: Rabindra Sarobar Metro / Mahanayak Uttam Kumar Metro
clusters.recommended_order: Mudiali Club → Chetla Agrani → Suruchi Sangha
clusters.notes: Art-forward pandals known for creative innovation

clusters.name: Naktala-Garia-Kasba Theme Corridor
clusters.recommended_order: Bosepukur Sitala Mandir → Rajdanga Naba Uday → Naktala Udayan Sangha → Santoshpur Lake Pally
clusters.notes: Major theme puja territory south of EM Bypass

clusters.name: Behala-Haridevpur Mega Circuit
clusters.recommended_order: Sabarna Roy Choudhury → Barisha Club → Behala Nutan Dal → Haridevpur 41 Pally
clusters.notes: South Kolkata's southern frontier. Heritage + modern themes.

clusters.name: Lake Town–Dum Dum Spectacular Zone
clusters.recommended_order: Sreebhumi Sporting Club → Lake Town Adhibasi Brinda → Dum Dum Park Tarun Sangha → Dum Dum Park Bharat Chakra
clusters.notes: Grand spectacle territory. Sreebhumi draws largest crowds in Kolkata.

clusters.name: Salt Lake Block Puja Circuit
clusters.nearby_metro: Salt Lake Stadium Metro / Karunamoyee Metro
clusters.recommended_order: FD Block → AE Block → other blocks

pandals.name: Bagbazar Sarbojanin Durgotsab
pandals.address: Near Bagbazar Launch Ghat, Bagbazar, Kolkata, West Bengal 700003
pandals.google_maps_query: Bagbazar Sarbojanin Durgotsab Kolkata
pandals.description: One of Kolkata's oldest and most iconic sarbojanin (community) Durga Pujas. Founded in 1919, Bagbazar Sarbojanin is renowned for its traditional Daker Saaj (pith decoration) on the idol and its authentic old-world Bengali Puja atmosphere near the Hooghly riverbank.
pandals.historical_significance: Among the pioneering community Durga Pujas that made the festival accessible beyond wealthy families. Known for strict adherence to traditional rituals.
known_for: One of the oldest community pujas
pandals.notes: Located near Bagbazar Launch Ghat on the Hooghly. Walking distance from Sovabazar-Sutanuti Metro.

pandals.name: Kumartuli Park Durga Puja
pandals.address: Banamali Sarkar Street, Kumartuli, Kolkata, West Bengal 700005
pandals.google_maps_query: Kumartuli Park Durga Puja Kolkata
pandals.description: Located in the heart of Kolkata's legendary potters' quarter (Kumartuli), this puja is celebrated for its innovative fusion of traditional idol-making craft with contemporary artistic themes.
pandals.historical_significance: Set in the traditional artisan quarter where Durga idols have been sculpted for centuries.
pandals.notes: Walking distance from Sovabazar-Sutanuti Metro. Best visited with Bagbazar and Ahiritola.

pandals.name: Ahiritola Sarbojanin Durgotsab
pandals.address: 55, B.K. Pal Avenue, Ahiritola, Kolkata, West Bengal 700005
pandals.google_maps_query: Ahiritola Sarbojanin Durgotsab Kolkata
pandals.description: A long-standing traditional puja near Bagbazar that balances traditional values with artistic, theme-based decorations and rich cultural programs.
pandals.historical_significance: One of the venerable community pujas of North Kolkata.
pandals.notes: 5-7 min walk from Sovabazar-Sutanuti Metro. Near B.K. Pal Avenue.

pandals.name: College Square Durga Puja
pandals.address: College Square, College Street, Kolkata, West Bengal 700073
pandals.google_maps_query: College Square Durga Puja Kolkata
pandals.description: Iconic Durga Puja celebrated beside the historic College Square tank. The reflection of the brilliantly illuminated pandal on the water creates one of the most photographed scenes of Kolkata Puja.
pandals.historical_significance: Set beside the historic College Square swimming tank surrounded by educational institutions.
pandals.notes: Near Mahatma Gandhi Road Metro. The water reflection at night is iconic.

pandals.name: Sovabazar Rajbari Durga Puja
pandals.address: 36, Raja Nabakrishna Street, Sovabazar, Kolkata, West Bengal 700005
pandals.google_maps_query: Sovabazar Rajbari Durga Puja Kolkata
pandals.description: One of Kolkata's most historic and famous Bonedi Bari pujas, founded by Raja Nabakrishna Deb in 1757 following the Battle of Plassey. Known for once hosting British dignitaries like Lord Clive and Warren Hastings.
pandals.historical_significance: Founded 1757 by Raja Nabakrishna Deb. One of the earliest Durga Pujas to be held in Kolkata. Connected to the British colonial history of Bengal. The puja is held at two separate locations (Borotorof and Chototorof).
pandals.notes: Raja Nabakrishna Street, Sovabazar. Near Sovabazar-Sutanuti Metro. Heritage Grade structure.

pandals.name: Khelat Chandra Ghosh Bari (Pathuriaghata)
pandals.address: Pathuriaghata, Kolkata, West Bengal 700006
pandals.google_maps_query: Khelat Chandra Ghosh Bari Pathuriaghata Kolkata
pandals.description: Established around 1855 by Babu Khelat Chandra Ghosh, a noted philanthropist. The mansion (Khelat Bhawan) is a Grade I heritage structure, famous for its long majestic thakur dalan, Belgian chandeliers, and deep association with Indian classical music.
pandals.historical_significance: Grade I heritage structure. Famous for its Belgian chandeliers and association with Indian classical music and dance. Established circa 1855.
pandals.notes: Pathuriaghata area. Grade I heritage structure.

pandals.name: Laha Bari Durga Puja
pandals.address: Pathuriaghata, Kolkata, West Bengal 700006
pandals.google_maps_query: Laha Bari Durga Puja Pathuriaghata Kolkata
pandals.description: Initiated by Bhagabati Charan Laha over two centuries ago. Known for its unique idol where the Goddess is traditionally not depicted in the standard Mahishasuramardini form. The puja rotates between different family branches.
pandals.historical_significance: Over 200 years old. Unique non-Mahishasuramardini idol tradition. Rotating family celebration.
pandals.notes: Pathuriaghata area. Puja rotates between branches including Bidhan Sarani and Muktaram Babu Street.

pandals.name: Sabarna Roy Choudhury Aatchala Bari
pandals.address: 67/3, Diamond Harbour Road, Barisha, Kolkata, West Bengal 700008
pandals.google_maps_query: Sabarna Roy Choudhury Barisha Kolkata
pandals.description: Widely regarded as the oldest Durga Puja in the Kolkata region, initiated in 1610 by Lakshmikanta Gangopadhyay (Roy Choudhury). One of the first Saparivara Durga Pujas. Today 8 separate pujas are held by family branches — 6 in Barisha, 1 in Birati, 1 in Nimta.
pandals.historical_significance: Oldest known Durga Puja in the Kolkata region (1610). Started by prominent zamindar family. Sabarna Sangrahashala (museum) at the site. Multiple family branch pujas including Aatchala Bari, Baro Bari, Mejo Bari, Benaki Bari, Kalikinkar Bhawan, and Majher Bari.
